# aggregate.generate_output_filename { #healpyxel.aggregate.generate_output_filename }

```python
aggregate.generate_output_filename(
    input_file,
    sidecar_file,
    output_dir=None,
    densified=False,
)
```

Generate output filename that matches the parseable structure of the sidecar.

Constructs a descriptive output filename by combining the input file stem
with the sidecar suffix and an optional densification marker.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type         | Description                                                           | Default    |
|--------------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| input_file   | Path         | Original input parquet file.                                          | _required_ |
| sidecar_file | Path         | Sidecar file being used (suffix is extracted from this).              | _required_ |
| output_dir   | Path or None | Output directory. Defaults to the same directory as ``sidecar_file``. | `None`     |
| densified    | bool         | If True, append ``-densified`` marker to the output filename.         | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | Path   | Output file path with format::      <stem>-aggregated[-densified].<sidecar_suffix>.parquet |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

For ``input=mascs_data.parquet`` and
``sidecar=mascs_data.cell-healpix_assignment-strict_nside-64_order-nested.parquet``:

* Sparse: ``mascs_data-aggregated.cell-healpix_assignment-strict_nside-64_order-nested.parquet``
* Densified: ``mascs_data-aggregated-densified.cell-healpix_assignment-strict_nside-64_order-nested.parquet``
